summary: Build a responsive single-page website for Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant (aka Mehfil Mandi House) featuring branding, contact CTA, location info, and a digitized menu with prices.
architectural_notes: Include 'Call Now' button linking via tel:6305855373.
Use red and white color scheme to match physical menu board.
Menu displayed as HTML table or grid with Single/Full prices and placeholders for remaining items.
Location section must show: 'Opp. Pillar No. 103, Attapur X Roads, Hyderabad'.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Circular restaurant logo/badge in red and white with decorative border and simple text styling (mehfil-logo-badge.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide hero/banner background with subtle red-and-white pattern or texture (mehfil-hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png)

existing_features.title: Create a responsive single-page website for the restaurant with a consistent red-and-white visual theme.

Implement a header section that displays the restaurant name “Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant” and includes the alternate name “Mehfil Mandi House” (e.g., as a subtitle or secondary label). Add a prominent “Call Now” button that links to tel:6305855373.
Add a Location section that displays the address text: “Opp. Pillar No. 103, Attapur X Roads, Hyderabad”.

Digitize the provided menu items into a clean table or grid layout with columns for Item, Single price, and Full price. Use “--” where a Single/Full price is not provided. Include placeholders for additional items not enumerated by the user (as stand-in rows/cards without specific pricing).
Generate and include basic restaurant branding imagery as static assets and display them on the page (e.g., logo badge and a subtle hero/banner graphic) while staying within the red/white theme.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a responsive single-page restaurant website with red/white theme, header with restaurant name and 'Call Now' tel:6305855373 button, location section, and a digitized menu table/grid with Single/Full prices plus placeholders for remaining items from the menu image.
